name: Seisui Friends.
source:
It's Valentine's day, and I'm just killing time with nothing to do...

"Excuse meee!"

My online friend and kouhai in my video game "Mizuki" had suddenly come over to my house!

She starts smirking as she notices the "urine themed" doujin in my room...
It seems like she's planning something...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE246194.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
今天是情人节，我只是无所事事地消磨时间……

“对不起喵！”

我的网上好友和我的电子游戏“水木”中的空海突然来到我家了！

当她注意到我房间里的“尿液主题”同人时，她开始傻笑……
看来她正在计划着什么……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE246194.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
